task.name: Get_camp_ice
task.when: During the Morning ice run or when the Dominatrix requests ice before an event

resources.resource: Approved payment method from the Dominatrix

step.action: Ask the Dominatrix to confirm the number of bags and give you the approved payment method.
step.ifThen: IF this is the normal Morning run and no different quantity is requested, THEN get 5 bags.

step.action: Take 📦 Handcart to Arctica at 3:00 and G during its posted open hours.
Purchase the confirmed number of ice bags.
Secure the ice bags on 📦 Handcart.
Put the ice bags in 🍷 Ice_Storage.
Return the payment method and any change or receipt to the Dominatrix.

passWhen.criterion: The confirmed number of ice bags is in camp ice storage.
The payment method and any change or receipt were returned to the Dominatrix.

problem.condition: Arctica at 3:00 and G is closed.
problem.response: Use another currently open Arctica location or return to camp and tell the Dominatrix.

reasoning.entry: The workbook's 3:00 and G location remains an official 2026 Arctica location; posted hours control because hours vary by event day.
